_about: 3-27 (R1 fix 1; re-flown for the knights that see and shoot, wave 3b-2 round 1): antiportal_2084 (scale 3, 96 px at 32 x scale) holds the keyhole, the yellow door
and the exit, and the key lies 48 px inside shock_agent_2048's 74 px ring, where the player dies but a knight does not; every portal here is 116 px or more
from the ring's centre. Left off the top platform onto the middle one while the knight holds at wayB1 with its back to him (facing right: it walked there). A
portal in the key's pocket at (80, 185) and one at the knight's post (232.4, 186): the knight goes into the pocket and takes the key (627-633). It sees the
player on the middle platform for the few ticks it falls (the one spot, 628) and then, standing on the pocket floor behind the pillar, nothing: it searches
and asks (698). The player MUST NOT be on the pillar top now (the first version of this route was shot there: the knight sees him, 28 px away, as its search
turns it right, and fires 41 ticks later); a portal on the left ledge at (50, 116) (tap 639, placed on 671) and one on the player (674) take him up onto it,
out of the knight's row (floor(y / 128) is 0 there and 1 for the knight), where the knight never sees him. A few steps right (682-685) to the ledge's corner
(x 60.5), from where the ray to the pocket clears the ledge block; a portal on the middle platform at (200, 180) (tap 702, placed on 744) and one over the knight
(750, placed on 777): out it comes at (200, 185) and lands facing right (its search had turned it), stands for the rest of the 5000 ms it serves
(the sighting of 628 restarted them) and walks left to wayB0 from 942, facing left with its back to the middle platform's right side. A portal at the small
block at (275, 120) (tap 780, placed on 841) and one on the player (844): out on the block, row 0, where the shock diamond is taken (852) and nothing sees him.
Left from 946, once the knight faces left and walks (a start before 942 would meet it facing right): off the block (256), down onto the middle platform behind
the knight and along it into its back (the diamond strikes it, 996; the key drops and is taken, 998). A portal at (270, 120) (tap 1004, placed on 1042) and one
at (190, 186.3) (tap 1046, placed on 1053) walked into (1048-1400): out moving right, over the block and down by the keyhole (key into it 1130, the door gone
1180); right into the door. Won on tick 1214. Each tap is 26 ticks or more after the last release (25 ticks is the 400 ms the original refuses) and after the
last shot has landed. Leans on G1a (the knight's cone, row and bucket, and the dwell the sighting restarts), G1b (its shot), G10 and G4.
